## Verdict
needs-revision

## Concerns
- The reusable lemma omits hypotheses needed for the asserted surjection \(\mathbb Z^{\#F_d}\twoheadrightarrow Q_d\), notably \(A_0=\mathbb Z\) and finite generation of the graded pieces. These hold in the intended Grassmannian quotient but must be stated; without them the lemma is false in general.
- The finite ranks, absence of torsion, and Hilbert-series identity for \([333,5^5]\) are otherwise preserved, and no universal conclusion is claimed.

## Unresolved certificates
- [proof-attempt] Restate and prove the basis criterion for a connected nonnegatively graded \(\mathbb Z\)-algebra with \(A_0=\mathbb Z\) and finitely generated graded pieces, then explicitly apply it to \(A=\Lambda/I_{5,5}\).
